verdicts.reason: A keeps a balanced, centred three-line headline with reasonable breaks. Its flaws: the 'Now in four flavours' subcopy is tiny and split off to the left of the CTA, and the bottom row sits too close to the canvas bottom and right edges. B pushes the headline to four lines with uneven breaks ('a little / sunshine.'). That leaves almost no top margin and a cramped gap above the CTA row, so the frame feels overstuffed. B also has the same tiny subcopy and the same tight bottom row as A.
